verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an Events API that lets you retrieve account activity, for example by polling POST /api/v2/auditevents, and forward it to a SIEM. That is a pull API, not registrable outbound HTTP webhook callbacks, so it is only an adjacent capability. Nothing in the pack shows 1Password letting a programmatic consumer subscribe to pushed events.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
